Overview

Luleå is a city in Norrbotten with a population of 79,000. A northern coastal city in the Arctic region, known for its steel industry, icebreaker tours, and midnight sun. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
